summary: This document describes a threat model for the setting in which External BGP path security mechanisms will be developed. It analyzes the RPKI and focuses on an Autonomous System's ability to verify the authenticity of the AS path information it receives.

eli5.summary: Before building a lock, you ask who might try to break in and how. This lists the ways someone could lie about the route a message takes across the Internet.

questions: how can as path be forged
